product_metadata.title: Nifty Expandable Roasting Rack – Easy-Grip Handles, Multipurpose Cooking Accessory, Chrome-Plated Steel, Dishwasher Safe, Heavy-Duty Design for Turkey, Ham, Goose, or Roast
features: EXPANDABLE ROASTING RACK: Use this multipurpose cooking accessory that expands to increase to the appropriate proportions of your roasting pan or meat size. It is easy to use and simply folds flat when not in use for cabinet storage

EASY-GRIP HANDLES: The rack allows you to effortlessly transfer your meal with the easy-grip handles from the cooking pan to a cutting board or serving platter. It is a simple cooking essential that will make prepping dinner easier for friends and family

DISHWASHER SAFE: Easily clean this rack after you are done cooking. It is made with chrome plated steel that makes cooking residue come simply clean either by hand washing or putting it in the dishwasher
DIMENSIONS: This roasting rack has a heavy-duty design that expands from 10 inches to 13 inches with overall dimensions of 10 inches in length, 8 inches in width, and 1 inch in height

HIGH-QUALITY PRODUCT: Nifty Solutions will solve your dilemma’s with high-quality and practical products. Keeping design in mind for your home, this roasting rack is made to last, hard to break, and easy to clean
